description: Angular component for displaying and managing a table of entities with features like pagination, sorting, filtering, and actions such as add, delete, and detail view. It integrates with NgRx store, Angular Material components, and custom services.

classes.name: EntitiesTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component for rendering and managing a dynamic entities table with features like sorting, filtering, pagination, and actions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up resize observer, and loads configuration.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and subscriptions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially re-initializing on config change.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up table configuration, sorting, pagination, and data source based on route parameters and config.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive form controls and subscriptions for filtering and route parameter changes.

methods.name: updatePaginationSubscriptions
methods.description: Subscribes to paginator and sort events to update route and data.

methods.name: addEntity
methods.description: Opens dialog or calls callback to add a new entity.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Loads data based on current pagination, sorting, and filters.

methods.name: deleteEntity
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a single entity.

methods.name: columnsUpdated
methods.description: Updates displayed columns based on configuration.

methods.name: cellContent
methods.description: Returns sanitized HTML content for a cell.

methods.name: cellTooltip
methods.description: Returns tooltip text for a cell.

methods.name: cellStyle
methods.description: Returns style object for a cell.
